summary: Graybar Electric Company, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on June 22, 2026, disclosing an amendment to its existing Prudential Shelf Agreement with PGIM, Inc. (Prudential). The amendment extends the issuance period to August 2, 2029, while other material terms remain unchanged. This is a routine financing arrangement with no acquisition, divestiture, activist, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change event. No specific terms such as price per share, premium, or expected close were disclosed. The filing is a standard current report updating a credit facility and does not constitute a special situation. No what-to-watch angle.
